meta.name: phase-101-search-evaluation-dataset
meta.referenceMatcher: MockServiceCatalogRepository.searchCategories (name/keyword substring containment over isApprovedForLaunch == true, mirroring SQL public.search_categories) plus MockProviderRepository.search (published listings that serve the queried locality).

fieldSemantics.id: Unique query id, q-tun-### for tuning and q-held-### for held_out.
fieldSemantics.split: tuning = safe to tune keywords against; held_out = never used for tuning, only for measuring.
fieldSemantics.language: en | hi (Devanagari Hindi) | mr (Devanagari Marathi) | romanized (Latin-script Hindi/Marathi) | typo | unsupported (wave-2 or healthcare domain).
fieldSemantics.queryText: What a Mumbai customer would type.
fieldSemantics.localityId: The customer's selected locality; provider search always filters on it.
fieldSemantics.expectedCategoryIds: Launch-approved categories a correct answer may use. Empty array = 'any launch-approved category is acceptable' (locality-style queries). Gap queries also leave this empty today; the target is stated in rationale.
fieldSemantics.expectedMinResults: Minimum provider listings the query must return today when > 0. 0 marks a documented current gap (empty today is the recorded baseline).
fieldSemantics.allowEmpty: True when an empty result is acceptable/expected today (gap queries and locality-style queries tolerate zero). False for queries that must resolve.
fieldSemantics.rationale: Why the query exists and what it measures.

meta.globalInvariant: No query may ever expose an unapproved wave-2/healthcare category through any catalog surface, and no provider search may return a listing that is not publicly listed (a listing with no launch-approved category).
